nodes.description: ERC20 private mapping(address=>uint256) _balances holding token balances.
ERC20 private nested mapping _allowances storing spender allowances per owner.
ERC20 private _totalSupply tracking minted token supply.
ERC20 private _name storage for token name.
ERC20 private _symbol storage for token symbol.
GeneratorCopyright private constant _GENERATOR url string.
GeneratorCopyright private _version string set at construction.
ERC20 constructor(string name_, string symbol_) initializes _name and _symbol.
ERC20.name() view returns _name.
ERC20.symbol() view returns _symbol.
ERC20.decimals() view returns hardcoded 18.
ERC20.totalSupply() view returns _totalSupply.
ERC20.balanceOf(address account) view returns _balances[account].
ERC20.transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public, delegates to _transfer with _msgSender().
ERC20.allowance(address owner, address spender) view returns stored allowance.
ERC20.approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public, delegates to _approve.
ERC20.transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public, checks and decrements allowance.
ERC20.increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public, adds to allowance.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public, subtracts from allowance.
ERC20._transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal, mutates _balances.
ERC20._mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal, increases _totalSupply and _balances.
ERC20._burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal, decreases _balances and _totalSupply.
ERC20._approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal, writes _allowances.
ERC20._beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual hook.
Context._msgSender() internal view virtual returns msg.sender.
Context._msgData() internal view virtual returns msg.data.
ServicePayer constructor(address payable receiver, string serviceName) payable, performs external payment call.
IPayable.pay(string serviceName) external payable interface entry point invoked by ServicePayer.
GeneratorCopyright constructor(string version_) sets _version.
GeneratorCopyright.generator() pure returns _GENERATOR constant.
GeneratorCopyright.version() view returns _version.
HelloERC20 constructor payable, forwards fee to ServicePayer and mints 10000e18 to caller.
msg.sender, caller controlled address used for authorization and initial mint recipient.
External payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) executed in ServicePayer constructor.
_balances[recipient] += amount arithmetic state update in _transfer.
_totalSupply += amount arithmetic state update in _mint.
_totalSupply -= amount arithmetic state update in _burn.
_allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue arithmetic addition in increaseAllowance.
currentAllowance - amount / currentAllowance - subtractedValue arithmetic subtraction for allowance updates.
_mint(_msgSender(), 10000e18) privileged supply creation in HelloERC20 constructor.
Constructor parameter name_ for token name.
Constructor parameter symbol_ for token symbol.
HelloERC20 constructor parameter feeReceiver_ address payable receiving the service fee.
recipient address parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
amount uint256 parameter of transfer/transferFrom/approve/hook.
spender address parameter of approve/allowance/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance/transferFrom.
sender address parameter of transferFrom/_transfer.
owner address parameter of allowance/_approve.
addedValue uint256 parameter of increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue uint256 parameter of decreaseAllowance.
account address parameter of balanceOf.
account address parameter of _mint/_burn.
from address parameter of _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
to address parameter of _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
receiver address payable parameter of ServicePayer constructor used as external call target.
serviceName string parameter passed to IPayable.pay.
version_ string parameter of GeneratorCopyright constructor.
Local currentAllowance read from _allowances in transferFrom.
Local senderBalance read from _balances in _transfer.
Local accountBalance read from _balances in _burn.
Local currentAllowance read from _allowances in decreaseAllowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by Context._msgSender and drives caller authorization.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source account whose balance is spent.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance check.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
the initial mint credits the caller returned by _msgSender().
transfer delegates token movement to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates token movement to _transfer.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state changes.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state changes.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state changes.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances state variable.
_mint increases the recipient entry of _balances.
_burn decreases the account entry of _balances.
_approve writes the _allowances state variable.
transferFrom loads the stored allowance into local currentAllowance.
local currentAllowance is used in the currentAllowance - amount subtraction.
increaseAllowance computes _allowances[...] + addedValue.
decreaseAllowance loads the stored allowance into a local variable.
local currentAllowance is used in the currentAllowance - subtractedValue subtraction.
_transfer performs _balances[recipient] += amount.
_mint performs _totalSupply += amount.
_burn performs _totalSupply -= amount.
amount parameter flows into the _transfer balance arithmetic.
recipient parameter determines the credited balance in _transfer.
sender parameter determines the debited balance in _transfer.
_transfer reads _balances[sender] into local senderBalance.
senderBalance - amount is committed to the recipient balance update.
_burn reads _balances[account] into local accountBalance.
account parameter is credited in _mint.
account parameter is debited in _burn.
ServicePayer constructor triggers the external payable call before construction completes.
receiver parameter is the external call target address supplied by the deployer.
serviceName parameter is forwarded to the external pay call.
external call enters IPayable.pay in an attacker controlled contract.
HelloERC20 constructor invokes ServicePayer constructor with feeReceiver_.
HelloERC20 constructor invokes ERC20 constructor.
constructor mints the fixed supply to the deployer without restriction.
name_ parameter is passed into the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ parameter is passed into the ERC20 constructor.
ERC20 constructor assigns _name from name_.
ERC20 constructor assigns _symbol from symbol_.
name() returns the _name state variable.
symbol() returns the _symbol state variable.
totalSupply() returns the _totalSupply state variable.

allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
name_ is forwarded by the HelloERC20 constructor.
symbol_ is forwarded by the HelloERC20 constructor.
feeReceiver_ is forwarded by the HelloERC20 constructor as fee receiver.
feeReceiver_ is bound to the ServicePayer receiver parameter.
version_ parameter is passed to the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
GeneratorCopyright constructor assigns _version from version_.
version() returns the _version state variable.
generator() returns the _GENERATOR constant.
recipient parameter is passed to _transfer from transfer.
amount parameter is passed to _transfer from transfer.
spender parameter determines the approve target.
amount parameter sets the approved allowance.
spender parameter is _msgSender() in the transferFrom allowance lookup.
amount parameter bounds the transferred and deducted value.
spender parameter receives the increased allowance.
addedValue parameter is added to the current allowance.
spender parameter receives the decreased allowance.
subtractedValue parameter is the amount removed from the allowance.
owner parameter indexes the allowance lookup.
spender parameter indexes the allowance lookup.
account parameter indexes the _balances lookup in balanceOf.
from parameter is supplied to the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
to parameter is supplied to the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
amount parameter is supplied to the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is only a constructor argument that initializes the _name state variable through the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ is only a constructor argument that initializes the _symbol state variable through the ERC20 constructor.
feeReceiver_ is consumed by the HelloERC20 constructor which forwards it to the payable service receiver.
recipient is a transient address argument that only selects the credited balance inside _transfer.
amount is a transient value argument that only participates in the _transfer balance arithmetic.
spender is a transient argument that only indexes the _allowances mapping written by _approve.
sender is a transient argument that only selects the debited balance inside _transfer.
owner is a transient argument that only indexes the _allowances mapping written by _approve.
addedValue is only used to compute the new allowance in the increaseAllowance arithmetic.
subtractedValue is only used to validate and reduce the allowance in decreaseAllowance.
account is a transient argument used only as the balanceOf mapping key.
account is a transient argument used only as the credited key in _mint and _burn.
from is only forwarded to the _beforeTokenTransfer hook signature.
to is only forwarded to the _beforeTokenTransfer hook signature.
receiver is the externally supplied address used as the target of the unsafe payable call.
serviceName is only forwarded as the argument of the unsafe external pay call.
version_ is only used to initialize the _version state variable in the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
currentAllowance is a temporary cache of the stored allowance consumed by the subtraction allowance update.
senderBalance is a temporary cache of _balances[sender] consumed by the _transfer balance update.
accountBalance is a temporary cache of _balances[account] consumed by the burn balance update.
currentAllowance is a temporary cache of the stored allowance consumed by decreaseAllowance.
